claim: edpediskctrl.dll ReadEncryptPartionInfoEx reads encrypted partition-label metadata from a GPT/MBR front-label base plus a relative sector offset; it does not dereference the legacy LBA7 Region A StartSector.
address_chain: sub_10021e20 stores sub_10031120(disk_number) into global dword_10091114.
sub_10031120 is logged as CDiskFunc::GetGptIndex and reads only the first 13 sectors before returning the label base index.
sub_100128d0 defaults its relative sector field to 0x0c when zero.
sub_100128d0 seeks to (dword_10091114 + relative_sector) * sector_size and reads relative_count * sector_size bytes.
No legacy LBA7 entry +0x18/+0x1c StartSector is used in this address calculation.
proves: ReadEncryptPartionInfoEx is a front-label/LBA12-family metadata reader, not a Region A payload consumer.
The EDPF magic parsed by this function is insufficient to bind it to Region A.
limitations: This closes only the analyzed edpediskctrl.dll build and this named path.
Another historical module or I/O mechanism may still consume the legacy Region A pointer.
